messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a patch release tonight: v1.4.2. Fixes: token refresh race (high priority) + small docs header tweak. Deploy window 22:00 PT. Need quick consensus on tagging and pinning policy.

Meera: Patch sounds right. No API surface changes?

Alex: No API changes. Pure bug/security fix.

TJ: Patch only then. Semantic versioning: patch for bug fixes; minor if any behavioural change or new endpoint. Keep tags prefixed with "v".

Sam: Agree. Also suggest we pin the k8s image in helm values to a digest so rollback is deterministic. Example in docs: 
```
image: 
  repository: ghcr.io/redwood/inference
  tag: v1.4.2
  digest: sha256:abcd...
```

Alex: Good call. For tagging, prefer annotated tags with release note summary. e.g. `git tag -a v1.4.2 -m "release: v1.4.2 token refresh race fix"` then `git push origin v1.4.2`.

TJ: +1 to annotated tags. Keeps changelog tooling happy. Also: branch name `release/v1.4.2` for the merge commit.

Meera: Two operational asks: 1) canary rollout at 10% for 30m, 2) rollback threshold = error spike >2% or latency P95 increase >150ms. If hit, automatic rollback to v1.4.1.

Sam: For Helm charts, also pin chart dependency versions and record the image digest in the release notes. I can update chart values during the RC.

release-bot: release-bot: created release candidate v1.4.2-rc.1 by @Alex (sha: 7f3d2b1). CI: all checks passed.

Alex: Thanks. Who will run the tag & cut the release?

Meera: I can cut after Sam updates the chart. Planning to do that ~21:15 PT.

Sam: Will push chart update and image digest by 21:10 PT.

TJ: Quick note on commit messages & tags: use structured tag body for the changelog generator. E.g.
```
release: v1.4.2

- fix: session token refresh race causing 500s
- docs: header formatting
```

Alex: Rollout plan:
- 22:00 PT start canary (10% traffic, us-west-2)
- 22:30 PT increase to 50% if stable
- 23:00 PT full (100%) if stable
- rollback immediate to v1.4.1 if threshold exceeded

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary rollout for v1.4.2 -> us-west-2 (10%). canary id: c-20260320-1

Meera: If everything is green after 30m, also post a short blurb in #incidents and #general with the changelog bullets.

Sam: Changelog bullets ready, will attach digest and chart sha in the release notes.

TJ: One more thing — tagging convention for hotfix branches: `hotfix/1.4.2` and merge back to main + release branch. Keep minor untouched.

Alex: Agreed. Decision: patch bump to v1.4.2, annotated tag with structured body, pin image to digest in helm values, canary rollout 10%/30m, rollback to v1.4.1 on thresholds. Meera to cut, Sam updates charts, TJ verifies changelog format.

Meera: I'll cut tag & trigger final pipeline at 21:20 PT.

release-bot: release-bot: v1.4.2 tag created and release notes published (short).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary healthy at 10% after 30m (no error spike). proceeding to 50%.

Alex: Thanks team — will monitor dashboards. Postmortem if anything flares. :thumbsup:

TJ: minor doc: update our release playbook to explicitly require digest pinning for all patch releases. Filing a quick PR now.

Sam: PR for chart values: #452 in infra-charts.

Meera: Closing loop: release complete, v1.4.2 rolled out to prod at 23:05 PT. Will add notes to release board.

Alex: Excellent.
